summary: Software engineer with 7 years building data-heavy web products and, for the last 2, LLM-backed features in production. Ships end to end: TypeScript services, evaluation harnesses, and the UI that makes model output trustworthy to users.

bullets.text: Led the design of a TypeScript LLM gateway serving 14 internal features, with per-team spend caps and provider fallback; cut model spend 38% while p95 latency fell from 9.1 s to 4.3 s.
Built an offline evaluation harness (2,400 labelled cases) that gates every prompt change in CI, catching 31 regressions before release in its first year.
Shipped structured-extraction for customer contracts, replacing a manual review queue and saving analysts ~120 hours a month.
Mentored 4 engineers through their first production AI features; wrote the team's guide to schema-validated model output.
Owned the scheduling service (Node.js, PostgreSQL) handling 1.2M appointments a month at 99.95% availability.
Migrated 40 background jobs to a Postgres-backed queue with idempotency keys, ending a class of double-booking incidents.
Introduced Playwright end-to-end tests for the booking flow, reducing escaped defects by roughly half over two quarters.
Built React dashboards and the REST APIs behind them for a B2B logistics product used by 300 shippers.
Wrote the CSV import pipeline that onboarded the company's three largest customers.
